item.title: Chrysos #4618 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scatter
item.description: Chrysos #4618 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Peismedes #2717 Siren-deaf was broken and is whole again (2×). The the Butes Choir made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Peismedes has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
